description: Complete a login started with login_anilist by submitting the URL your browser was redirected to after clicking Approve (the one containing ?code=...). Use this when login didn't complete automatically — e.g. the server runs on a remote/headless host. Pass the whole URL, not just the code: its `state` is checked against the login attempt, so a bare code or a URL from another login is rejected. Fails if no login is in progress (e.g. the server restarted since login_anilist) — run login_anilist again.
name: submit_anilist_redirect
title: Complete AniList login with a pasted redirect URL
